title: LexiconEntryDraft
description: What the drafting model must return for one term. The pipeline adds term, evidence_stats and provenance afterwards.

aliases.description: Other spellings or near-synonyms seen in the contexts.

gloss.description: Plain-language meaning in neutral terms, as people who use it would describe it.

traditions.description: Traditions where this sense is typical, or ['all'].

feature.description: A feature id from the controlled vocabulary, or 'proposed.<id>'.

disambiguation_question.description: One neutral question Stage 0 can ask when a user says this term. Empty string if the term is unambiguous.

neutral_options.description: For contested terms: 2-4 positions, each described as its own adherents would. Empty otherwise.

relevance.description: Decided last. church_vocabulary = church terms a newcomer or someone from another tradition may need explained (the usual answer); logistics_term = practical visiting vocabulary; not_relevant = only filler, sign-offs, boilerplate, personal names or phrase fragments. Such terms are dropped.
